summary: Independent review of the frozen specification against the non-CI runtime and test changes in a78bcc80 and baseline e23b0668. The criteria preserve old approval records and retry identity, bind hooks to repository schemas and distinguish legacy task fallback from mandatory incoming observation bindings. The schema acceptance cases exercise same-length same-timestamp changes to referenced content. Shared readers, mutation handshake, lazy imports and SDK Git environment retain explicit compatibility checks. The existing task scope covers the necessary callers and V1 verification. No open design findings.
